name: Conveyor
hint: Ride the belts, and nobody gets left on the ground floor.
why4: The lift up the 6-high deck only rises with all four aboard; one player alone can never get the team past it.
solution: Timing: the screen scrolls 1 t/s; its left edge reaches the ferry (x=22) at t=22 s, the lift (x=38) at t=38 s and the bridge (x=48) at t=48 s; the last screen (x>=80) is static from t=80 s. Worst case the ferry has both pairs across by t~16 s.
Everyone hops the bump at x=9-10 and jumps the 2-wide pit at x=14-15.

Ferry: the 2-wide mover shuttles in the 7-wide pit between x=22 and x=27 (2 t/s, 5 s round trip). P1 and P2 step on when it is at x=22 and step off right at x=29 when it reaches x=27; P3 and P4 take the next trip (about 10 s for both).
Everyone steps onto the lift at x=38-41 (4/4): it rises 6 tiles (3 s); step right onto the deck at x=42.
Fragile bridge (holds 2) over the 6-wide pit at x=48-53: P1 and P2 walk across together, then P3 and P4.
Jump the 3-wide pit at x=60-62; drop off the deck end at x=72 onto the floor.

Final screen: the 2-wide mover at x=86-87 goes up and down between the floor (y=15, over a pit) and y=9 (1.5 t/s). P1 steps on at the bottom, rides up, steps right onto the floating shelf at x=88-92 (1 higher), touches the key at x=90, and drops down.
P1 opens the door at x=105; all press Down.
Recovery: anyone popped drops back in above the teammate furthest behind; a broken bridge regrows after 3 s.
